Bug_Details:
Overriding method is missing a call to overridden super method API providers may annotate a method with an annotation like
androidx.annotation.CallSuper or
javax.annotation.OverridingMethodsMustInvokeSuper to require that overriding
methods invoke the super method. This check enforces those annotations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the Derived class's doSomething method, where the super.doSomething() call is intentionally omitted.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the Derived class, which in turn calls the overridden doSomething method without invoking the super class's doSomething method.
